characters.name: LIISA
characters.description: Väike inimene, armas tüdruk punakate patsidega, seljas punane sügismantel, jalas sinised kummikud, rõõmus näoilme ja suured uudishimulikud silmad. Armas multifilmistiil.

characters.name: JUKU
characters.description: Väike inimene, armas poiss pruunide juustega, seljas roheline sügisjope, jalas kollased kummikud, lõbus ja sõbralik naeratus. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: Sügisene aed
locations.description: A bright cozy autumn garden with green lawn covered in colorful yellow and red fallen leaves. In the background stands a small wooden house with yellow walls and a red tiled roof. A simple wooden fence surrounds the yard, and behind it are trees with bright orange, red, and golden autumn leaves. Sunny sky with soft light. Simple, cheerful children's book style.

pages.scene: Liisa (girl with ginger pigtails, red autumn coat, blue boots) and Juku (boy with brown hair, green jacket, yellow boots) standing together in the cozy garden, smiling cheerfully at each other. Autumn leaves are scattered on the green lawn. In the background is the yellow wooden house with a red roof, a wooden fence, and golden autumn trees. Landscape orientation. The scene fills the whole picture edge to edge, with the ground continuing all the way to the bottom edge (no empty band at the bottom).

The scene fills the whole picture edge to edge, with the ground continuing all the way to the bottom edge (no empty band at the bottom).

The scene fills the whole picture edge to edge, with the ground continuing all the way to the bottom edge (no empty band at the bottom).

Liisa is holding a small blue children's rake, carefully sweeping colorful autumn leaves together across the green lawn. Juku stands nearby holding his red rake. Background shows the cozy yellow wooden house with red roof and golden trees. The scene fills the whole picture edge to edge, with the ground continuing all the way to the bottom edge (no empty band at the bottom).

Liisa and Juku stand side by side proudly behind a massive, huge pile of gathered yellow, red, and orange leaves in the center of the lawn. Juku jumps high into the air with arms spread out, about to land right into the big giant pile of colorful autumn leaves. Liisa stands next to the leaf pile, cheering joyfully. Liisa jumps happily right into the middle of the big leaf pile, splashing colorful autumn leaves into the air all around her. Juku sits on the edge of the leaf pile, laughing and clapping. Yellow house in background. The scene fills the whole picture edge to edge, with the ground continuing all the way to the bottom edge (no empty band at the bottom).

Liisa and Juku sit together right inside the soft pile of golden leaves, surrounded by bright colorful fall foliage. They both have big joyful smiles on their faces, resting together in the cozy garden with the yellow house behind them.
